listing.name: Rayman 2: The Great Escape (n64hub)
listing.summary: A Windows port of Rayman 2: The Great Escape. Set it up with your original US Nintendo 64 game file.

steps.title: Prepare your Windows copy
steps.instruction: Use a complete Windows x64 copy that you are permitted to use. Install the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable (x64) if needed. Open Rayman2Recompiled.exe, choose Load ROM and select your own 32 MiB, big-endian Rayman 2 USA .z64 (SHA-1 50558356b059ad3fbaf5fe95380512b9dceaaf52). Choose Start Game.

warnings: Keep your current profile and Controller Pak files when replacing the program. The project reports early-game progress. Later levels and save compatibility across releases are unverified.

references.title: Setup instructions for the inspected release

listing.download_block_reason: Portcove downloads are paused until the applicable permission for the bundled Fontworks Chiaro fonts is established or upstream publishes a package with appropriately licensed replacements. You can add a complete copy you are permitted to use.

data_locations: %LOCALAPPDATA%/Rayman2Recompiled by default, or the game folder if it already uses portable.txt; saves/controllerpak_1.mpk and other Controller Pak files under that profile
